import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Compute effect sizes and p-values for all features
    effects = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        x = feats.x[:, i]
        y = feats.y
        mean1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        mean0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        effect_size = mean1 - mean0
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y == 1], x[y == 0], equal_var=False)
        effects.append((fid, effect_size, p_val, t_stat))
    
    # Sort by effect size (largest first) and p-value (smallest first)
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: (-abs(x[1]), x[2]))
    
    # Select top candidates
    candidates = [f for f, _, _, _ in effects[:10]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    selected = []
    for fid in candidates:
        if not selected:
            selected.append(fid)
        else:
            x1 = feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)]
            is_unique = True
            for fid2 in selected:
                x2 = feats.x[:, feats.column(fid2)]
                corr = np.corrcoef(x1, x2)[0, 1]
                if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                    is_unique = False
                    break
            if is_unique:
                selected.append(fid)
    
    # Check if any mechanism exists
    if len(selected) == 0 or np.random.rand() < 0.8:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Use top 2 as drivers if available
    drivers = tuple(selected[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Include all selected features in the model
    columns = tuple(selected)
    
    # Create interaction terms between drivers
    products = []
    for i, d1 in enumerate(drivers):
        for j, d2 in enumerate(drivers[i+1:], i+1):
            products.append((d1, d2))
    
    # Return design with selected features
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings={fid: 1.0 for fid in columns}
    )
